restaurant_name: TANN Dental Clinic (Dental Wellness and Aesthetics)
text:
The clinic is conveniently located within a few minutes walking distance from the MRT silom station. Despite its central location, the clinic itself has quite spacious spaces and the fees are very reasonable unlike the private hospitals in Bangkok.

The staffs were friendly and helpful. The dentist was professional and resourceful. He explained very patiently on all the questions and concerns I had on Invisalign. As the clinic is located in Silom (the heart of LGBTQ+ community in Bangkok), it is refreshing to see that they have an "LGBTQ+ friendly" sign put up in their highlight. I will surely visit this place again. Highly recommended! Thank you Khun Mhor Win for superb services ka.
